description: Unit test class for the snapshotting functionality of the PolicyPersistenceActor in Eclipse Ditto, testing policy creation, modification, deletion, snapshot creation, and recovery behavior.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorSnapshottingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing snapshotting behavior of policy persistence actor, including creation, modification, deletion, and recovery scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for tests with custom configuration including adapters and command-to-event mappings.

methods.name: convertJournalEntryToEvent
methods.description: Converts a BSON journal entry to an Event object with assigned sequence number.

methods.name: convertDomainIdToPersistenceId
methods.description: Converts a PolicyId to a specific persistence ID string.

methods.name: convertSnapshotDataToPolicy
methods.description: Converts BSON snapshot data into a Policy object, verifying revision consistency.

methods.name: deletedPolicyIsSnapshotWithCorrectDataAndCanBeRecreated
methods.description: Test verifying that deleted policies are correctly snapshotted and can be recreated after restart.

methods.name: policyInArbitraryStateIsSnapshotCorrectly
methods.description: Test ensuring policies in various states are accurately snapshotted with correct data.

methods.name: snapshotIsCreatedAfterSnapshotIntervalHasPassed
methods.description: Test verifying snapshot creation after defined interval if changes occurred.

methods.name: snapshotsAreNotCreatedTwiceIfSnapshotHasBeenAlreadyBeenCreatedDueToThresholdAndSnapshotIntervalHasPassed
methods.description: Test ensuring no duplicate snapshots are made if already created due to threshold and interval.

methods.name: assertSnapshotsEmpty
methods.description: Helper to assert that no snapshots exist for a specific policy.

methods.name: assertJournal
methods.description: Helper to verify journal entries match expected events.

methods.name: toEvent
methods.description: Converts a command to its corresponding event with revision.

methods.name: assertSnapshots
methods.description: Helper to verify snapshots match expected policies.

methods.name: assertPolicyInSnapshot
methods.description: Checks that a snapshotted policy matches expected policy data.

methods.name: assertPolicyInResponse
methods.description: Checks that a retrieved policy matches expected data and revision.

methods.name: assertEqualJson
methods.description: Helper to compare two policies based on their JSON representations.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Pauses test execution for the specified duration.
